title: Jessie the barmaid and trying to get on the bandstand
summary: Washing glasses for the Italians, he sat by barmaid Jessie and was thrown out whenever he asked the bands to let him sing.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: So I get kicked out but I never gave up. I used to go back down to the clubs. So after I started workin' with the I-talians, I was ... Tendin' to help the lady washin' the glass. I wasn't tendin' no bar. A friend of mine, y'know I knew, she used to be a barmaid, so I knew her, so she let me come in there.
"I got a message for her...from her momma."

So the man on the door let me in. So I go in there and talk to Jessie. Thought she put me... She set me on a chair an' set me beside the bar. Now, if you set there, you could listen to the music awhile afore you gotta go home. [Coughs.] Boy, she was a bit older than me, so...she's a very pretty girl, too. So that helped a lot. So she was a barmaid. So while she's tendin' bar an' everything, I'd sit there and listen to the music. When she get busy, I'd sneak over to the bandstand:
They would throw me out all the time.

I told 'em my Uncle Charlie taught me how to sing. So everybody know Uncle Charlie. All the musicians did. He was a piano player in another place down the street. So...after I'd bugged everybody around there, I got so...I don't care nothin' about goin' to nightclubs. I just go on about my business.
